result.brief: 提出 Inter-X++ 大规模人-人交互基准与 OpenHHI 统一表征建模框架，联合优化交互重建与语义理解，覆盖生成与感知任务。
result.reason: Human-human interaction benchmark with unified representation jointly optimizing reconstruction and semantic understanding; motion-centric, not video/multimodal foundation world model or visual representation learning.
